summary: Regression verification completed through the public endpoint. All 11 backend pytest cases passed, the frontend production build compiled, all requested desktop workflows passed, mobile responsiveness passed, and no React console errors, undefined-variable errors, or key warnings were observed across Dashboard, ReportView, ComparePage, CumulativeView, History, Settings, and GenerateReport.

issues: Week date still uses the browser-native input[type=date] picker instead of the existing shadcn calendar/date-picker pattern.

action_items: Replace the native week-date input with the shadcn calendar/date picker for consistent cross-browser UX.

Add catch/finally handling and retryable error states to initial API loads in Dashboard, History, Settings, ReportView, ComparePage, and CumulativeView so rejected requests do not leave indefinite loading states.
critical_code_review_comments: Initial page-loading API calls generally lack rejection handling; a network/API failure can leave loading indicators indefinitely or produce an unhandled rejection rather than a user-visible retry state.

Settings allows arbitrary program names, but report_engine._prog_from_series classifies only hardcoded B.Com/BBA/PGDM/BCA values; a newly configured program cannot be mapped into its configured report column.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested functional regression flows passed

seed_data_creation: Created one API sample report, one TEST_Small upload report, and one UI sample report; all were deleted after verification. The two pre-existing ready sample reports were preserved. Settings verified_logic was temporarily changed to all and restored to any.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend coverage now includes sample matrix values, NI-to-COLD mapping, publisher CPA/direct-spend recalculation and persistence, cumulative publisher aggregation/export, trends, settings, list/get/delete, upload, exports, and missing-resource errors. Frontend verified all requested pages and edit/save/delete/navigation flows with clean console output. The previous stale Additional Attributed total, React key warning, and mobile overflow defects are fixed.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional regression was found. Stable React keys eliminate the prior reconciliation warning, update_amounts now assigns the Additional Attributed Applications total, and responsive Layout classes/drawer remove the former mobile overflow. Remaining findings are pre-existing UX/error-state gaps, not regressions from this refactor.
